newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Hazawa Corp bankrupt with 23.3 bln yen debt.
newsitem.headline: Japan Hazawa Corp bankrupt with 23.3 bln yen debt.

text.p: Unlisted Japanese construction firm Hazawa Corp said it was declared bankrupt by Tokyo District Court on Thursday with debts of 23.3 billion yen.

An official at the Tokyo-based construction firm confirmed a report by leading Japanese credit research company Teikoku Databank Ltd that the court had accepted the firm's bankruptcy application, which was filed on July 18.
Teikoku said Hazawa, established in 1966, had been suffering from weak sales amid a prolonged construction industry slump as well as worsened business conditions for its affiliates.
